title: Synchronize Aggregator Selection Across Windows
description: Aggregator: selection changes must synchronize live between all windows (for example Top and Perspective). Diagnose the cross-window selection propagation path, fix the root cause without making per-window view options shared, extend existing tests, and verify runtime behavior.
summary: Fixed Aggregator live selection synchronization by publishing each active World3d marquee preview through a controller-scoped external store and rendering that preview in sibling windows while preserving per-window camera and view options. Added ownership-safe cleanup so idle panes cannot cancel an active gesture, plus focused regression coverage. Verified in the running Aggregator that a held marquee in Top highlights the matching object in Perspective before pointer-up, with no browser console errors. Focused Vitest remains blocked before test collection by the existing Puzzle 2D WASM output-name mismatch; renderer lint remains blocked by its existing reference to the old index.tsx filename.
